name: Ohio Pride PAC
identity_line: Ohio Pride is Ohio's only statewide LGBTQ+ PAC.

pride_135.use: Thin dividers, tags, stripes, donate button fill. Never a background field. Never inside the wordmark.

wordmark.rule: Use the official asset. Never rebuild from type, recolor, stretch, rotate, or add gradient.
wordmark.construction: OHIO Montserrat 600 white, PRIDE Montserrat 800 light blue, PAC small label centered on a hairline divider beneath.
wordmark.clear_space: Height of the O in OHIO on all sides

favicon.mark: OP monogram (white O, light blue P) over a Progress Pride underline on navy

rules: One idea per tile: one headline, one support line, one CTA max. Two ideas means a carousel.
Headline Montserrat ExtraBold, 70 to 85 percent of canvas width, 3 lines max. Support line Roboto Slab, small. No middle type sizes.
Navy fields, light blue accents. Pride gradient is an accent device only.
Accountability posts use the villain palette: near-black field, white type, one warning accent. Never for endorsements or celebrations.
One brand mark per card. Wordmark same position and scale on every template. Never rebuilt from type.
Endorsement cards: candidate name and race primary, tagline secondary. Candidate logos used exactly as designed on a light field, never recolored.
Real Ohioans over stock. Alternate photo cards and flat color cards so the 9-grid reads designed.
No URLs on graphics. No swipe cues or slide numbers on carousels. No fake tappable buttons.
Never obstruct a subject's face with type.
No disclaimer on organic social graphics or captions.
Accessibility floor: 4.5:1 contrast, alt text on every post, captions on all video, body type 40px or larger at 1080 wide.
Social cards should feel editorial and alive, fun or funny where the moment allows. The flat stacked-template look is retired.

versions: PAC (we voice, IG and FB shared)
captions.first_line: No commas in the first line
captions.emojis: 2 to 4 total. Never in the first three words. Never inside hashtags.
captions.identity_line_close: PAC captions close with the identity line on launches and resource drops only.

voice.summary: Confident, not loud. Institutional in feel, neighborhood in voice. Warm, neighbors not activists, receipts not rage.
voice.audience: Persuadable independents and purple-state voters, not only the base.
voice.punctuation: No em dashes or en dashes anywhere. Use periods, commas, colons, semicolons.
voice.headlines: IG headlines take no commas; body copy may.
avoid: naming peer advocacy orgs in comparison copy

compliance.disclaimer: Paid for by Ohio Pride PAC.
disclaimer_rules: No personal names in the disclaimer.
Required on paid placements, mail, print, and signage.
Not used on organic social graphics or captions.
compliance.firewall_races: Races where the Director personally advises the candidate get descriptive copy only: no express advocacy, no vote for, no comparative endorsement language.
compliance.judicial_candidates: Descriptive copy only. No policy pledges, no opponent attacks.
